messages:
maria (Sales AE): Pinebridge follow-up on SIG Q12.5/Q12.6 1: they want concrete artifacts proving master/key rotation cadence. POC handoff Friday. Need quick list of items we can share. cc @ben @jordan

ben (Security Eng): Short list: 1) Rotation policy (pdf) with statement of CMK 90d rotation; 2) CloudTrail export showing EnableKeyRotation / RotateKey events; 3) sample runbook for app-key re-encryption; 4) screenshot of key metadata showing LastRotated timestamp. Note: screenshots can be sanitized.

jordan (Sales Eng): Also include a short technical note explaining envelope encryption vs CMK rotation so they don't conflate Q12.5 and Q12.6. Suggest a 1-page explainer. I'll draft it.

maria (Sales AE): Are we allowed to share CloudTrail extracts or are there policy hoops? Pinebridge requests raw timestamps for verification.

lydia (Compliance): You can share sanitized event extracts. Full production logs require SEC-EVIDENCE ticket and explicit approval. If they insist on raw logs, we'll need NDA and Legal sign-off. Use pseudonymization for IAM principals and S3 paths.

ben (Security Eng): Plan: I'll generate a 90-day CloudTrail query and a separate 6-month RotateKey sample. Commands I'll run: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time 2024-05-01 --end-time 2024-08-31` and `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=ReEncrypt --start-time 2024-01-01 --end-time 2024-07-01`. Output will be CSV, then I'll mask ARNs and S3 URIs.

audit-bot: NOTE: Exporting audit logs requires SEC-EVIDENCE approval. File attachments should be uploaded to JIRA SEC-EVIDENCE-4412 only.

maria (Sales AE): Created SEC-EVIDENCE-4412 with Pinebridge contacts and use-case. Requested delivery Friday COB.

ben (Security Eng): I'll attach files to the JIRA: `cmk_rotation_policy.pdf`, `cloudtrail_rotation_sanitized.csv`, `app_reencrypt_runbook.md`, `key_metadata_sample.png` (sensitive fields redacted). ETA: Thursday afternoon.

jordan (Sales Eng): For the app re-encryption artifact, include a small snippet of the job log (sanitized). Example:
```
2024-06-01T02:00:00Z INFO starting re-encrypt job for tenant=***REDACTED***
2024-06-01T02:00:05Z INFO re-encrypted 4 keys total
2024-06-01T02:00:07Z INFO completed
```
That should satisfy SIG reviewers without exposing ARNs.

lydia (Compliance): Also include a short statement about key custody: where CMKs are managed (Redwood-managed CMK for Hosted) vs customer-managed for Private. Pinebridge is 'Hosted with VPC' per opportunity notes, so we provide CMK artifacts.

maria (Sales AE): Pinebridge asked if we have an automated proof-of-rotation feed (to prove 90d cycles automatically). Can we offer a periodic attest doc?

ben (Security Eng): We don't publish a live feed. We can provide a signed attestation (pdf) with rotation timestamps and a hashed bundle of the exported events. If they want live monitoring, that's an enterprise feature request.

maria (Sales AE): OK will propose attestation + sanitized logs. If Pinebridge accepts, we'll close the POC evidence loop. I'll share draft language and route to Legal if they ask for raw. Thanks all.
